name: ClickUp
tagline: A work-management app with built-in AI for writing, summarising, answering questions and automating tasks.
about: ClickUp combines tasks, documents, chat and goals. Its AI answers questions from your workspace content, writes and summarises, and automates routine steps.
pros: Tasks, documents, chat and goals in one app.
AI answers questions using your workspace content.
cons: The number of features can feel overwhelming.
AI is a paid add-on on most plans.
